limitations: Repository-only. The reconciler's route-mutation (--apply) is TWO-LEVEL DARK (needs MONITORING_GATEWAY_ENABLED + MONITORING_ENROLMENT_RECONCILE_ENABLED, both default OFF) and reserves/registers routes ONLY — it NEVER marks a route READY, contacts a host, mutates a Tailscale policy/bridge/account/workspace, places an order, or touches Copy Trading. NOT merged, NOT deployed; the production --apply backfill is a separate Sponsor-gated step.
Migration-free: no new model/field. Reuses the ADR-0075 MonitoringRoute models + the ADR-0100 reason taxonomy + the ADR-0072/0033 eligibility codes; adds one default-OFF flag (env-var, no migration).

The read-only dashboard enrolment PROJECTION is default-safe (ADR-0100 precedent: no flag) and production-active: it derives each account's stage from durable records (endpoint state, workspace projection, snapshot freshness) with NO host contact, and it NEVER changes the account universe — it annotates it.

The LIVE /mt5/positions demo gate (account_not_demo, ADR-0072) is UNCHANGED and explicitly NOT lifted here; a LIVE account still monitors balance/equity/deals and reads READY, with its positions limitation carried as a per-capability note.

The per-account 12-account live readiness TABLE was NOT re-probed against production (the packet's HARD STOP forbids host contact). Each account's stage is produced by the same code-level projection and is available via the read-only `reconcile_monitoring_enrolment report` command once run with production DB access (a separate, read-only step).

A pre-existing LOCAL jsdom quirk (window.localStorage.clear is not a function) fails 3 dashboard page test files identically on the clean base commit (verified by stash) — unrelated to this change; CI's frontend environment is unaffected.

reviewer: 5-lens adversarial review (tenant-isolation/endpoint-identity; dashboard-math/stale-data/false-zero/double-count; idempotency/concurrency/duplicate-routes; operational-failure/alert-quality; security/leakage) with adversarial verification of HIGH/CRITICAL. 6 findings: 2 HIGH (both CONFIRMED real) + 2 MEDIUM + 2 LOW — ALL fixed with regression tests. HIGH-1: snapshot_fresh now judged on the latest EQUITY-BEARING row (equity__isnull=False) to match the equity-curve coverage anchor exactly (a balance-only fresh row no longer falsely reads monitored). HIGH-2: a reserved-but-unverified MonitoringRoute (readiness UNKNOWN) no longer overrides a genuinely-READY account — the projection prefers the route only on a determinate readiness and otherwise falls back to the active-record projection. MEDIUM: alert resolution gated on a POSITIVE READY (never auto-resolves a genuine alert on a fail-open/degraded stage); alert management decoupled from the dark route-mutation flags (runs in --apply). LOW: ALLOC_REACTIVATED tallied as 'unchanged' (dropped misleading 'registered'); freshness constant pinned to the ledger by a new regression test. Host-write safety, credential/PII/secret leakage, tenant isolation, universe-never-shrunk, fail-closed and Copy-Trading isolation all CLEAN.
